title: Kinetic offer wall
objective: Make one legitimate offer readable while showing the product range.
timing_status: Beat timing rendered as a NodeTool timeline; recheck it with your own assets.
creative_status: Reusable motion concept with generated illustrative stills. Use approved product assets and claims for production.
assets_required: Approved offer, end date and terms
visual_invariant: The offer is the hero; repetition creates texture but never competes with the readable offer.

beats.composition: Oversized offer occupies the upper-middle canvas; one pack is already visible.
beats.motion: Word-staggered entrance, 75 ms offset; 260 ms per word; background rows drift 0.08 canvas widths.
beats.qa: Offer readable by 500 ms; no empty opening.

beats.composition: Three products share a consistent center and baseline.
beats.motion: Cut to a new pack every 500–750 ms. Each enters 0.12 widths over 240 ms, overshoot <=6%.
beats.qa: No scaling of legal text; cutout edges clean.

beats.composition: Hero product grows while repeated copy recedes.
beats.motion: Slide background text off; product scale 1.00→1.08; benefit pops once.
beats.audio_cue: Music continues; no new competing cue.
beats.qa: One benefit only; offer remains understandable muted.

beats.composition: Offer, eligible product range and end date become a stable card.
beats.motion: 180 ms fade for supporting line; otherwise hold.
beats.qa: Actual client terms, not unapproved terms.

beats.composition: Stable brand/product/CTA lockup.
beats.motion: CTA settles within 200 ms; hold the remaining time.
beats.qa: Final frame complete; no fade to black.

fallback: Use explicitly duplicated text clips when repeaters are not exposed by the host.
watch_out: Never fabricate a discount or urgency.
Constrain repeater copies to a parent group ending at the cut.
Keep all stagger delays inside the text clip window.
variants: 6 s: hook 1 s, product range 3 s, CTA 2 s.
15 s: add one benefit beat, not more offer words.

selection.use_when: An approved offer is the main reason to act, with a small product range.
selection.avoid_when: The value proposition needs explanation before price matters.
selection.motion_principle: Fixed offer hierarchy; product swaps change supporting evidence, never the offer.
selection.rating_basis: Editorial implementation estimate, not measured ad performance.

acceptance_criteria: Offer remains legible during every product swap.
Terms remain readable at placement size; extend the hold if necessary.
The final brand and CTA are fully settled and readable before export ends.

title: Fixed glyph, changing world

timing_status: Beat timing rendered as a NodeTool timeline; recheck it with your own assets.

beats.composition: One large glyph/icon and a short premise.
beats.motion: Anchor settles in 250 ms.
beats.qa: Do not borrow a zero-fee claim unless it is true and fully qualified.

beats.composition: Two worlds appear around the same anchor.
beats.motion: Cut every 1500 ms; supporting objects move tangentially or scale gently.
beats.qa: Anchor position is identical across cuts.

beats.composition: Two more worlds expand the range.
beats.motion: Repeat timing; vary palette and surrounding objects, not the anchor geometry.
beats.qa: Do not introduce a new grammar on every cut.

beats.composition: Worlds clear to reveal the concrete promise.
beats.motion: 300 ms exits; anchor stays.
beats.qa: Promise is explicit and substantiated.

beats.composition: Anchor becomes part of the brand/CTA lockup.
beats.motion: Hold.
beats.qa: No imitation of the original jingle or protected brand assets.

fallback: Use 2D cutouts orbiting a fixed circle or original icon; do not pretend this matches the original CG material work.
watch_out: Validate the proposed visual anchor with the intended audience; no performance claim is supplied.
If the anchor is part of a trademark, use the client’s own licensed mark.
variants: 6 s: two worlds only.

selection.avoid_when: The anchor has no clear meaning or the changing worlds obscure it.
selection.motion_principle: The anchor silhouette and position remain identical across world changes.

title: Calm breathing-shape loop
objective: Create a deliberately calm product-demo or wellness-style ad.
timing_status: Beat timing rendered as a NodeTool timeline; recheck it with your own assets.
creative_status: Reusable motion concept with generated illustrative stills. Use approved product assets and claims for production.
assets_required: Original simple shape or licensed character layers
visual_invariant: One clearly observable expansion/contraction cycle carries the experience; the design is quiet rather than empty.

beats.composition: Friendly simple form and a short invitation are present immediately.
beats.motion: Soft 350 ms opacity entrance; no hard flash.
beats.qa: Do not imply a medical or therapeutic outcome.

beats.composition: Form expands slightly around a stable center.
beats.motion: Custom scale 1.00→1.08 with easeInOut; shadow changes subtly.
beats.qa: Scale amplitude restrained; text stays still.

beats.composition: Form returns to its resting size.
beats.motion: Scale 1.08→1.00 using the same easing.
beats.qa: Do not animate all text with the character.

beats.composition: Show one supported product benefit, not a health promise.
beats.motion: 180 ms text fade; form rests.
beats.qa: The 3-second phases are design timing, not a clinical breathing recommendation.

beats.composition: Brand, invitation and next step hold.
beats.motion: Subtle 1–2% motion or none.
beats.qa: If seamless loop is required, make first/last visual states match.

fallback: Use circles and rounded rectangles instead of character deformation; build expressions from separate simple layers.
watch_out: A calm visual style does not establish advertising effectiveness.
Complex squash/morphing needs compatible path geometry or original animation assets.
variants: 6 s: a single small expansion/contraction cycle plus stable CTA.
Use a non-looping end card when acquisition clarity matters more than a seamless loop.

selection.avoid_when: Urgency, a detailed feature explanation or an unsupported health claim drives the ad.
selection.motion_principle: Use a complete, gentle cycle with no abrupt scale reset.
selection.rating_basis: Editorial implementation estimate, not measured ad performance.

acceptance_criteria: Expansion and contraction settle without a jump.
If exported as a loop, first and last displayed states join cleanly; otherwise use an end card.

beats.qa: Input has enough resolution for the chosen crop.

beats.motion: Use an authentic clip or swap between approved state images.
beats.qa: Do not invent charging speed, security behavior or sensor capabilities.

beats.composition: Reveal the full product.
beats.motion: Match cut to full-product asset; align the feature before the cut.
beats.qa: A full 3D orbit requires geometry or rendered footage, not a flat crop.

beats.motion: Text fade, no new camera move.
beats.qa: Qualifications remain legible.

beats.composition: Product, brand and CTA.
beats.motion: Hold.
beats.qa: End frame contains the actual client product.

fallback: Use a high-res still for the macro and a match cut to a second still. Avoid fake perspective rotation.
watch_out: Keep original product geometry and labels accurate.

timing_status: Beat timing rendered as a NodeTool timeline; recheck it with your own assets.
creative_status: Reusable motion concept with generated illustrative stills. Use approved product assets and claims for production.
assets_required: Front-facing product frame or app/window frame with transparency
visual_invariant: The result and the product window align spatially; a mask explains the relationship.

beats.composition: The impressive output fills the scene.
beats.motion: Minimal motion; one short result label.
beats.qa: Use an actual output or label a concept visualization honestly.

beats.composition: Product/window frame appears over the aligned result.
beats.motion: Frame slides or fades in over 300 ms; underlying image alignment does not jump.
beats.qa: Crop and frame corners align pixel-for-pixel.

beats.composition: Window content shows a relevant change or detail.
beats.motion: Mask bounds or crop animate; use a real before/after only where truthful.
beats.qa: Do not fake quality improvements or manufacture before/after evidence.

beats.composition: Pull back to an intelligible product-plus-result composition.
beats.motion: Group scale 1.08→1.00; benefit fades in.
beats.qa: Maintain shared aspect ratio inside the frame.

beats.composition: Result, product and next step remain visible.
beats.motion: Hold.
beats.qa: Qualification/disclosure survives the crop.

fallback: Use an original rectangular app frame instead of a physical device; front-facing geometry avoids corner-pinning requirements.
watch_out: Use an actual product output for a published demonstration; the landscape/device image is a concept.
For angled screens, use a verified perspective path or pre-rendered asset.
variants: NodeTool: show an actual generated/editable output inside the real application frame.
Square: reduce empty vertical space, preserving frame alignment.

selection.avoid_when: Perspective alignment or product provenance cannot be established.
selection.motion_principle: Match the result and the window exactly; let the frame explain provenance.
selection.rating_basis: Editorial implementation estimate, not measured ad performance.

acceptance_criteria: Mask edges show no leaks, seams or drift during transforms.
The depicted output actually comes from the demonstrated product.

title: A capability sequence on connected paths
objective: Explain an onboarding or service journey in a compact diagram.
timing_status: Beat timing rendered as a NodeTool timeline; recheck it with your own assets.
creative_status: Reusable motion concept with generated illustrative stills. Use approved product assets and claims for production.
visual_invariant: A continuous visual path communicates progression; one node is active at a time.

beats.composition: First node and the desired outcome appear together.
beats.motion: Node pops in 240 ms; short headline settles.
beats.qa: The diagram is not presented as a literal measured customer timeline.

beats.composition: Path connects the first and second nodes.
beats.motion: Stroke trim grows over 500 ms; second node activates on arrival.
beats.qa: Use a compatible authored path or static line fallback.

beats.composition: Next node becomes active.
beats.motion: Repeat the same motion grammar; previous node dims slightly.
beats.qa: Labels stay close to their nodes.

beats.composition: Final node completes the journey.
beats.motion: Trim finishes; final node gets one restrained emphasis.
beats.qa: No invented customer logos or endorsements.

beats.composition: Entire journey is visible with a concrete next step.
beats.motion: Pull back <=8%; hold CTA >=2 s.
beats.qa: Avoid shrinking the diagram below phone legibility.

fallback: Use static connector lines and staggered circle/icon entrances; no path animation is strictly required.
watch_out: Do not use a portrait as a testimonial without authorization.
In 9:16, use a vertical path rather than compressing a wide diagram.
variants: 9:16: vertical progression.
4:5 or 1:1: a three-node horizontal journey can work with short labels.

selection.use_when: The order of onboarding or service steps is the message.
selection.avoid_when: Benefits are independent rather than sequential.
selection.motion_principle: Follow one continuous path with a single active stage.
selection.rating_basis: Editorial implementation estimate, not measured ad performance.

acceptance_criteria: The active stage and direction of travel remain unambiguous.
Each stage label describes a real step in the intended order.
The final brand and CTA are fully settled and readable before export ends.
